Derivative/bump variants, non-Rec709 color conversion, negative offsets and 64-bit identities are CPU-compared on Linux. Plain native graphs replay on four GPUs; UV-driven complete render also passes. Other domains, general bump state, production image coverage and all native RIDs remain open; strict differences persist.

Resident ImageManager transport: eight formats, four filters and four extension modes; 115,650 original-CPU sampling cases. 128 native graphs plus 176 typed projection/derivative programs total 1,824 evaluations; 14 invalid inputs reject. Sampling and 768 native graph evaluations replay on four GPUs. Typed image/box/environment projections and derivative variants currently execute on Linux only. The complete generated-image textured native render has independent CPU-film and repeated-GPU gates. Strict differences, tiled/mipmap cache/retry, sparse 3D, production decoder/color/UDIM/animation/edit coverage, original asset materials and all native RIDs remain open.

Native static-triangle normal/tangent CPU comparisons: 48 compiled graphs, 398 typed programs, 10704 evaluations and ten explicit rejections. Native-generated UV frames, transforms/instances, base/convention/strength, radial axes and analytic derivatives are tested. Graphs, selected nonzero derivatives and full image-normal-mapped render replay on four GPUs. Full bump state, motion/other geometry, degenerate plain-tangent nonfinite behavior, original asset materials and all native hosts remain open; strict differences persist.
